'''Large Logs''' are fallen trees found on [[the Farm]]. A single large log is found in [[Cindersap Forest]] (blocking the entrance to the [[Secret Woods]]). Another large log is found blocking a [[The Alleyway Buffet|secret passage]] to the east between the [[Blacksmith]] and [[JojaMart]]. Large Logs can also be found on floors 41-69 of [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|the Dangerous Mines]]. A [[Axes|Steel Axe]] (or better quality) is required to remove a large log, yielding 8 [[Hardwood]] (10 with the [[Skills#Foraging|Forester]] profession) and 25 [[Foraging]] Experience points. Large Logs will never reappear once removed.

[[File:Secretwoods entrance.png|thumb|left|380px|Entrance to the [[Secret Woods]] location with the log blocking it.]]{{Clear}}

==Trivia==
Destroying a large log takes:
* 9 hits with a Steel Axe
* 7 hits with a Gold Axe
* 6 hits with an Iridium Axe
* 5 hits with a [[Forge#Enchantments|Powerful]] Gold Axe
* 3 hits with a [[Forge#Enchantments|Powerful]] Iridium Axe
